message: I ordered two cartons of oat milk and only one came in the bag.
The bananas arrived but the strawberries I paid for are not in the bag.
I asked for full-fat milk and got skimmed milk instead.
My slot was 6 to 7pm, it is now 9pm and the order still shows pending.
Three eggs were cracked when I unpacked the box.
The courier left the bags at the wrong flat, not at my door.
Only three of the five apples came, the rest are missing.
The yogurt tubs were split open and leaking over the other shopping.
I got a bag of brown rice but I ordered basmati rice.
The order was due this morning and it came after noon.
Two of the four bottles of juice were in the bag, not all four.
The driver would not wait at the door while I got my card.
